hypothesis: A correct flash-style GQA attention (no S^2 materialization, no 12x KV expand) plus straightforward Triton GEMMs beats the materialized reference.
design_delta: baseline decomposition A: generic tiled GEMM (BLOCK 64x64x32) for Q/K/V + output proj, fused RMSNorm(fp32)+RoPE elementwise kernel, flash attention (GQA kv_head=h//12, causal, online softmax fp32, BLOCK_M=BLOCK_N=64). No autotune.

static_validation.notes: GQA kv_head=h//12; causal keeps j<=i; RoPE full-128 rotate_half with sign(-1 low half,+1 high half); RMSNorm var+rsqrt in fp32; all GEMM/PV accum fp32; OOB masked on M,N,K; grep confirms no Torch compute op in path.

reason: PASS 5/5, geomean 1.7135x. Becomes the frontier. Per-workload: biggest win on large single-batch S=1024 (2.25x, memory-bound attention win dominates); smallest on tiny M=128 (1.46x) and largest M=2984 B=8 (1.60x) where the untuned GEMMs cap the gain -> confirms H2 (GEMM tiling) as next lever.

hypothesis: H2: the projection + output GEMMs are the FLOP bottleneck (~650 GFLOP vs ~55 attention); replacing the fixed 64x64x32 unswizzled GEMM with an autotuned, L2-swizzled (GROUP_M) matmul using fp32 tl.dot(a,b,acc) and an EVEN_K fast path recovers cuBLAS-competitive throughput and lifts geomean.
design_delta: Single delta vs c001: _gemm_kernel replaced by @triton.autotune (8 configs over BLOCK_M/N/K, GROUP_M=8, num_warps/stages) with grid-swizzle, modulo-wrapped A/B row/col loads, EVEN_K branch (K=4096 and K=12288 both divisible by 64 -> no inner K mask), masked store. RMSNorm+RoPE kernel and flash-attention kernel byte-identical to c001.

static_validation.notes: GEMM math identical (C=A@Bw^T+bias, fp32 accum, bf16 store); EVEN_K path safe since both K values %64==0; modulo wrap on M/N loads harmless because store is masked to M,N; grep confirms no Torch compute op in path (only comments/docstring mention linear).

reason: PASS 5/5, geomean 2.3308x vs c001 1.7135x (+36%). H2 confirmed: tuned GEMMs are the dominant lever. Biggest jumps on small-M (S=128: 1.46->2.55) and largest-M (B8 S373: 1.60->2.33) cases where c001's untuned GEMM capped throughput. New frontier = c002. Attention kernel now the next-largest remaining share.
